attempts.summary: WebDAV is operational at http://node1:8080/documents/. The supplied editor account has authenticated CRUD access; anonymous requests receive 401; exclusive locks reject tokenless overwrites with 423 and accept token-authorized updates. Original project files remain unchanged. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were retained, and all functionality recovered after a verified node reboot.
